tokens.name: coat
tokens.usage: Coat, the brand's teal: the doorman's coat and the primary colour. The action colour on light (links, the primary button, the docs header). Paper on Coat 6.14:1; Coat as text on bg 6.14:1, on surface 6.53:1.

tokens.name: coat-deep
tokens.usage: Coat deep: the doorman's collar and sleeves, dark panels, the docs header in dark. Paper on Coat deep 11.03:1.

tokens.name: face
tokens.usage: The doorman's face zone, a step lighter than the coat. Drawing only, never text or UI.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: Lamp, the warm light: the doorman's buttons, braid, hat band and cuffs; the org avatar's ground; the light launch card; the action colour in dark. On light it is a fill only, never text (1.71:1 on Paper). Night on Lamp 10.02:1.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Night: text and the wordmark on light; the dark background; one-colour logos on light.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper: the light background; text, the wordmark and one-colour logos on dark and on Coat; the knob and note in door glyphs.

tokens.name: hat
tokens.usage: The top hat: black, a London hotel doorman's, never green. Drawing only.

tokens.name: mitten
tokens.usage: The dark mittens (white gloves under a top hat read as a magician). Drawing only.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text ratios in the notes below are on bg, surface and code-bg.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: cards and callouts.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings. On bg 17.10:1 light, 15.86:1 dark; surface 18.19 / 14.53; code-bg 15.64 / 14.53.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, the terminal prompt. On bg 6.83 / 7.90, surface 7.27 / 7.23, code-bg 6.25 / 7.23.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Pending text: the waking page's step not reached yet; the docs' lightest text. Misses 4.5:1 in light (3.53 on bg, 3.75 on surface); dark 4.91 / 4.50. Source value kept: never use it in light for text someone has to read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and callout borders, list rules, the waking page's floor and step rules. Decorative (1.30:1 / 1.39:1 on bg): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The action colour: links, the primary button's fill, the secondary button's text and border, the focus ring. As text on bg 6.14 / 10.02, on surface 6.53 / 9.17.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill: the primary button's label, any button on hover. 6.14:1 / 10.02:1.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: Coat on light, Lamp on dark, as the docs theme sets them.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Teal as text or icon ink where it isn't an action: UI icons, small accents on brand pages, the docs' note and tip admonitions. On bg 6.14 / 7.22, surface 6.53 / 6.61. Never a fill under Paper text in dark (2.37:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Amber as text. Lamp can't be text on light, so amber text there is #8A5A00: on bg 5.57, surface 5.93, code-bg 5.10; in dark it is Lamp, 10.02 / 9.17 / 9.17. Also the terminal block's resuming tone and the docs' warning admonition.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks and the terminal block (the docs' code background).

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Text in code blocks. On code-bg 15.64 / 13.34.

tokens.name: docs-header
tokens.usage: The docs site's header bar and tabs (Material's primary colour).

tokens.name: on-docs-header
tokens.usage: Text and the one-colour logo on the docs header: 6.14:1 light, 11.03:1 dark.

tokens.name: asleep
tokens.usage: Asleep (paused), as text: state words, badges, scene labels. On bg 5.54 / 7.12, surface 5.89 / 6.52, code-bg 5.07 / 6.52. On the light scene floor 4.36, below 4.5:1 (source value kept).

tokens.name: waking
tokens.usage: Waking up (resuming), as text. On bg 4.70 / 10.02, surface 5.00 / 9.17. On light code-bg 4.30, below 4.5:1, so the terminal block uses accent-text for resuming. On the light scene floor 3.70 (source value kept).

tokens.name: awake
tokens.usage: Awake (running), as text. On bg 5.02 / 8.11, surface 5.34 / 7.42, code-bg 4.59 / 7.42; light scene floor 3.95 (source value kept). Awake and error have nearly the same lightness (1.02:1 light): never tell them apart by colour; the word and the door come with them.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Needs you (needs attention), as text: the Needs attention heading, condition names, the needs-you callout's title, the docs' danger admonition. On bg 5.11 / 5.99, surface 5.44 / 5.49, code-bg 4.68 / 5.49; light scene floor 4.02 (source value kept).

tokens.name: glyph-slate
tokens.usage: The closed door in the asleep and needs-you glyphs. As a mark on bg 5.07:1 / 6.47:1.

tokens.name: glyph-leaf
tokens.usage: The door leaf swung inside the waking glyph.

tokens.name: glyph-amber
tokens.usage: The waking glyph's outline and floor wedge. 1.71:1 on light bg: the glyph reads by its leaf and its shape, and its word is always beside it.

tokens.name: glyph-room-amber
tokens.usage: The lit room inside the waking glyph.

tokens.name: glyph-green
tokens.usage: The awake glyph's outline, lamp and floor light. As a mark 3.16:1 / 8.11:1.

tokens.name: glyph-room-green
tokens.usage: The lit room inside the awake glyph.

tokens.name: glyph-red
tokens.usage: The exclamation on the needs-you glyph's pinned note.

tokens.name: scene-wall
tokens.usage: The wall behind the doors: README header, social preview, docs hero, ScenePanel, the building and its mass. Room names on it: scene-label. Also the room in an empty doorway (not judged, setting up) and the closed shutters of a room the building doesn't fill.

tokens.name: scene-floor
tokens.usage: The floor. State words sit on it: in light they fall below 4.5:1 (asleep 4.36, waking 3.70, awake 3.95, needs you 4.02, bold 12 px). Source values kept; a light scene's state words are captions, never the only place a state is named. Also the dark room behind a door going to sleep, or one whose light Napwake has turned off, and the street under the building.

tokens.name: scene-frame
tokens.usage: Door frames in scenes. In the building, also the round window under its dome and a shuttered room's surround, sill and louvres (decorative).

tokens.name: scene-frame-soft
tokens.usage: The door frame on the waking page: lighter than scene-frame in light.

tokens.name: scene-leaf
tokens.usage: A door's leaf in scenes and on the waking page.

tokens.name: scene-leaf-edge
tokens.usage: The line down a closed door's leaf.

tokens.name: scene-knob
tokens.usage: Door knobs in scenes.

tokens.name: scene-room-amber
tokens.usage: Lamp light: the room behind a waking door, also on the waking page and the launch card. Night on it 14.51:1.

tokens.name: scene-amber
tokens.usage: The wedge of light on the floor from a waking door (opacity light-wedge).

tokens.name: scene-wedge
tokens.usage: The breathing wedge on the waking page and in the wake animation.

tokens.name: scene-room-green
tokens.usage: The room behind an awake door. Night on it 15.60:1.

tokens.name: scene-green
tokens.usage: The green lamp over an awake door.

tokens.name: scene-green-glow
tokens.usage: Green light on the floor (opacity light-glow) and the lamp's halo (lamp-halo).

tokens.name: scene-label
tokens.usage: Room names over doors (dev, staging). On scene-wall 5.01:1 / 6.10:1. Also the dashed arch of an empty doorway (not judged, setting up) and its glyph, door-other: as a mark on bg 5.48:1 / 6.10:1, on surface 5.83 / 5.59.

tokens.name: scene-guest
tokens.usage: The guest standing in an in-use room: a silhouette in the room's light, an arch for the body and a circle for the head. Building only. On scene-room-green 15.60:1 light, 14.45:1 dark.

tokens.name: note-pin
tokens.usage: The red pin and exclamation on the pinned note, in scenes and in Pins a note.

tokens.name: doorman-coat
tokens.usage: The doorman's greatcoat; the waking page's done step and footer mark.

tokens.name: doorman-coat-deep
tokens.usage: Collar, sleeves, the coat's seam, pocket flaps and hem band.

tokens.name: doorman-brass
tokens.usage: Buttons, braid, hat band, collar piping, cuffs and the key ring.

tokens.name: doorman-hat

tokens.name: doorman-mitten

tokens.name: doorman-mitten-line
tokens.usage: The finger line on a pointing mitten.

tokens.name: doorman-shoe

tokens.name: doorman-shoe-rim
tokens.usage: The rim around each shoe.

tokens.name: doorman-eye

tokens.name: doorman-night

tokens.name: prop-clipboard

tokens.name: prop-switch
tokens.usage: The light switch in Lights out.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Big Shoulders Display ExtraBold: h1 and marketing headlines only.

styles.name: display-1
styles.sample: Non-prod environments that sleep when nobody's using them, and wake when someone does.
styles.usage: h1 and headlines: the docs home, posters, the launch card (64 px there), the social preview (60 px). Never below 32 px.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Card titles and section titles on brand pages, door hangers, the sticker.

styles.name: display-figure
styles.usage: The one lead figure on a report or a share card, with its label and source under it in body or small. 96 to 150 px on pages, scaled with the viewport, and 160 to 260 px on cards. One per page. Headlines stay display-1.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Regular and Bold: everything from h2 down, so long reference pages don't shout.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Paused workloads free the CPU and memory they requested; your node autoscaler turns that into a smaller bill.
styles.usage: Body copy on brand pages and callouts.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Every number carries its source or its assumption.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, 400 and 700: commands, output, labels.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Commands, code and the terminal block.

styles.name: state-label
styles.usage: State words and eyebrow labels, set in capitals (CSS text-transform: uppercase).

groups.name: Waking page
groups.note: The waking page loads nothing, so it uses the system's fonts.

styles.name: waking-title
styles.usage: The waking page's h1 (27 px under 720 px wide).

styles.name: waking-lede
styles.sample: This environment was paused while nobody was using it.
styles.usage: The waking page's paragraph, in muted.

styles.name: waking-step
styles.usage: The waking page's steps; the address under the title is 17 px weight 500.

spacing.note: The source has no formal scale. These are the steps its pages use most (the brand book, the waking page, the docs theme); its odd values (10, 14, 18, 22 px) stay where they are.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps; inline code padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: A state glyph to its word; small gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; gaps in grids of small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and callout padding; gaps in card grids; the terminal block's padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The page gutter on brand pages; gaps between large cards; the waking page's side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The waking page's header and footer padding; a button's side padding (2em at 16 px).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between the waking page's scene and its text.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Section padding on brand pages.

radius.note: Square-shouldered, soft corners. Doors are arches, never rounded rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (.3rem in the docs) and the terminal block.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Docs cards and the hero image (.4rem); callouts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and state cards on brand pages.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The avatar's circle crop, as GitHub shows it.

shadow.note: Interfaces are flat: they separate with line, not shadows. Shadows are for mock-ups of things in the world.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of the action colour (Coat 6.14:1 on bg, Lamp 10.02:1). Added by this system: the source sets no focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: A terminal window in a mock-up.

tokens.name: shadow-print
tokens.usage: Swag shown on a surface (sticker, hanger, key fob).

tokens.name: light-wedge
tokens.usage: The amber wedge from a waking door (the waking page's breathes between .55 and .3).

tokens.name: light-glow
tokens.usage: Green light on the floor from an awake door.

tokens.name: lamp-halo
tokens.usage: The halo around the green lamp over an awake door.

tokens.name: cast-shadow-dark
tokens.usage: The doorman's cast shadow in a dark scene.

tokens.name: cast-shadow-light
tokens.usage: The doorman's cast shadow in a light scene (.12 on the waking page and the light launch card).

tokens.name: ground-shadow
tokens.usage: The ellipse under a standing pose.

tokens.name: grain-dark
tokens.usage: The wall grain in a dark scene.

tokens.name: grain-light
tokens.usage: The wall grain in a light scene.

tokens.name: ease-calm
tokens.usage: Every interface and scene transition, turning the lights off included.

tokens.name: ease-breathe
tokens.usage: The breathing wedge on the waking page and in the building.

duration.note: Short in interfaces, slow for ambient loops.

tokens.name: duration-ui-short
tokens.usage: The shortest interface transition. Turning a room's light off, its lamp goes out in this.

tokens.name: duration-ui-long
tokens.usage: The longest interface transition. Turning a room's light off, the room goes dark in this, from 150 ms, then the door swings shut in it, from 600 ms.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: One room after the next when Napwake turns the lights off in a building: top floor first, left to right.

tokens.name: duration-beat
tokens.usage: The pause before a building's lights go off, once it is 55% in view.

tokens.name: duration-breathe
tokens.usage: One breath of the waking page's wedge, and of a waking room's wedge in the building.

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: One loop of an ambient scene (the wake transition). Also the asleep page's blink: once every loop.
